cards.title: Client-independent Admin
items: Admin is a Space, not an app. Codex, Claude, and Antigravity are the primary intended clients.
Hermes or another client can participate through a configured integration.
Codex and Claude wiring was verified. Antigravity and Hermes wiring is not verified here.

cards.title: One Admin memory service
items: Hindsight bank admin is the selected shared Admin memory.
Native host memory is app-internal and intentionally outside this view. Existing stores and links are preserved.
Instructions and live configuration remain authoritative at their owning sources.

cards.title: Native explorer
items: Open http://localhost:9999 and select bank admin. See tools/hindsight/README.md.
The UI connects to the existing API at 127.0.0.1:9077. It can also edit memory.
This is a conceptual configuration view. Local storage does not imply offline extraction.
